processes.name: Voluntary resignation & offboarding
processes.summary: Turns a resignation into a clean, compliant exit: confirm the resignation, decide on a counteroffer, fix the notice, garden leave and last-day terms, protect IP and controlled technology, then settle pay, equity and benefits by each jurisdiction's deadline and capture exit insight. Covers every voluntary exit worldwide (retirement is OF-08). Good looks like a confirmed last day within 1 business day of notice, final pay on time in 100% of cases, access removed by the end of the last day (at notice for high-risk leavers), and a signed return-of-property certification on file.
processes.owner: HRBP (process), People Ops (execution), Security with Legal (trade-secret triage)
processes.trigger: Employee gives written or verbal notice of resignation to the manager or HR, or submits it through the Darwinbox resignation workflow.
outputs: Resignation acknowledgment letter confirming the last working day, notice/garden-leave terms and pay-through date
Darwinbox termination transaction with employee-stated and manager-view reason codes, regretted flag and rehire code
Completed T-OFFBOARD-CHECKLIST: knowledge transfer, access-removal timestamps, asset return and signed return/deletion certification
Trade-secret risk triage record (and ER-10 case file where high risk)
Final pay statement plus country exit documents (e.g., CA 1089 notice, ROE, relieving letter, Taiwan service certificate, 离职证明)
Exit survey response and exit interview notes (OF-07)
processes.sla: Resignation logged and last day confirmed within 1 business day; access off by end of last day; final pay by the work-location deadline (e.g., CA last day with 72h+ notice, India 2 working days, ON later of 7 days or next payday).

steps.label: Submit written resignation
steps.detail: Employee submits the resignation through the Darwinbox workflow or in writing to the manager, stating the intended last day. The HRBP confirms verbal resignations in writing within 1 business day. In Canada, allow a short cooling-off conversation first, because a heat-of-the-moment resignation may not bind.

steps.label: Notify HRBP; flag regretted status
steps.detail: Manager tells the HRBP the same day and classifies the exit as regretted or non-regretted using the defined criteria (calibrated rating, critical-skill list, succession gap). The manager also records the destination if known (direct competitor, PRC-linked firm, startup, outside the industry). Managers do not promise counteroffers or early release before HRBP guidance.

steps.label: Counteroffer warranted?
steps.detail: HRBP and Dept Head decide within 2 business days, only for regretted, critical-skill employees, applying the CO-05 guardrails (market data, internal equity, pay-equity check). Skip the counter when the stated reason is the manager, the role or a relocation; money rarely fixes those.

steps.label: Present approved counteroffer
steps.detail: Manager and HRBP present the approved offer in writing (base adjustment and/or retention RSUs on a new vesting schedule) with a short decision deadline, typically 48 hours. For California employees, no stay-or-pay repayment terms (AB 692). Record the offer in the Comp planning tool.

steps.label: Accepts counteroffer?
steps.detail: If the employee accepts, they withdraw the resignation in writing and the HRBP cancels the transaction. In India, withdrawing a resignation before its effective date is common, so accepting a withdrawal is at company discretion under POL-52.

steps.label: Confirm last day, notice, garden leave
steps.detail: HRBP sends an e-signed acknowledgment fixing the last working day and whether notice is worked, spent on garden leave or waived, with pay through that date. Early release is not neutral. In California it becomes a discharge (immediate final pay) unless pay continues through the notice period. In Ontario, waiving notice can amount to dismissal, so pay out at least the ESA portion. In India, recover a notice buyout only as the contract allows.
steps.control: Darwinbox will not submit the transaction until the last day and the jurisdiction's final-pay deadline are recorded.

steps.label: High trade-secret or export risk?
steps.detail: Security and Legal triage every engineering, product and sales exit on three factors. (1) Destination. (2) Access: RTL and netlists, PDK and foundry data, tapeout schedules, customer roadmaps, TCP-controlled technology. (3) A 30-90 day DLP look-back for bulk downloads, personal cloud uploads or USB use. High-risk exits go to ER-10; the rest keep normal last-day access removal.

steps.label: Run ER-10 protocol; restrict access
steps.detail: Cut or restrict access at notice and move the employee to garden leave where the contract allows. Preserve and forensically image devices, extend the DLP review, and have Legal send a confidentiality reminder letter with DTSA and Rule 21F-17 carve-outs. Trade Compliance updates license provisos and the technology control plan register for foreign-national licence holders.

steps.label: Execute knowledge-transfer plan
steps.detail: Manager and employee complete the knowledge-transfer section of T-OFFBOARD-CHECKLIST. Design files and scripts go into managed repositories. In-flight blocks and tapeout tasks are documented. EDA project permissions and customer/FAE relationships are reassigned, and open approvals are delegated. All transfer happens on company systems; nothing is copied to personal devices.

steps.label: Enter termination; trigger tasks
steps.detail: People Ops submits the Darwinbox termination with reason codes, the regretted flag and the rehire code. This auto-creates IT, Facilities, Payroll, Benefits and Stock Admin tasks. Visa holders are flagged to Immigration the same day. Section 16 officers and NEOs are flagged to Legal for Form 8-K Item 5.02, due 4 business days from notice.
steps.control: Visa-holder and Section 16 flags auto-route; Immigration and Legal acknowledge within 1 business day.

steps.label: Run exit survey and interview
steps.detail: The T-EXIT-SURVEY invite goes out after notice with the country privacy notice. The HRBP, never the manager, holds the T-EXIT-INTERVIEW in the final week. Allegations of harassment, discrimination, retaliation, safety, fraud or export issues go to Employee Relations within 1 business day (OF-07).

steps.label: Send equity and benefits statements
steps.detail: People Ops sends one exit statement built from Stock Admin and Benefits inputs. Equity: unvested awards forfeit on the termination date per plan; each vested option's exercise deadline is stated (ISOs lose ISO status after 3 months); ESPP withdrawal and refund follow the plan; the insider trading policy still applies while the person holds MNPI. Benefits: end date, COBRA/Cal-COBRA or conversion rights, and the 401(k) 402(f) notice. China participants are removed from the SAFE Circular 7 registration.

steps.label: Remove access; recover assets
steps.detail: At the scheduled time on the last day (earlier if s8 applied), IT disables SSO, VPN, email, Git/EDA, cloud and lab-badge access. IT collects the laptop, tokens, dev boards and lab notebooks and gets the signed return-of-property and data-deletion certification. Remote leavers get a prepaid return kit (CA LC 2802). Final pay is never held back for unreturned items (CA LC 221).
steps.control: Timestamped deprovisioning ticket; weekly HRIS-to-identity reconciliation.

steps.label: Pay final wages by local deadline
steps.detail: Payroll pays final wages, any required PTO or leave payout and earned commissions by the deadline for the work location: CA on the last day with 72h+ notice (otherwise within 72 hours); ON the later of 7 days or the next payday; BC within 6 days; India F&F within 2 working days; Taiwan immediately; China at termination. A second reviewer approves before release, and deductions are taken only where lawful.
steps.control: Maker-checker approval of final pay; deadline tracked on the off-cycle ticket.

steps.label: Issue exit documents; close file
steps.detail: People Ops issues the country documents and files them in Document management under the retention schedule: US state separation or UI notices; CA 1089 notice and DE 2320; Canada ROE; India relieving/experience letter, Form 130 and PF exit; Taiwan service certificate on request plus insurance withdrawal; China 离职证明 plus social insurance transfer within 15 days.

steps.label: Retained; withdrawal documented
steps.detail: HRBP records the withdrawal, cancels offboarding tasks and adds the employee to the regretted-risk watchlist for a stay conversation within 90 days (EN-03).

raci.activity: Notice, garden leave and last-day terms
Trade-secret and export risk triage (ER-10 escalation)
HRIS termination transaction and task orchestration
Final pay and statutory exit documents

controls.control: The final-pay deadline is calculated from the work location and exit type when the termination is entered; Darwinbox blocks submission without a last day and notice date.
controls.evidence: Darwinbox termination record with deadline field; off-cycle payroll ticket

controls.control: Every leaver's access is disabled by the end of the last day (at notice for high-risk leavers). A weekly reconciliation compares HRIS terminations with active identity, VPN and EDA accounts.
controls.evidence: ITSM deprovisioning ticket timestamps; weekly HRIS-to-IdP reconciliation (SOX ITGC)

controls.control: Trade-secret triage is completed before the last day for every engineering, product, sales and TCP-flagged exit.
controls.evidence: Triage form in Case management with DLP review summary

controls.control: A second reviewer approves final pay, including PTO/leave payout and deductions, before release.
Equity forfeitures in the equity platform match the HRIS termination dates (stock-based compensation, SOX).
A signed return-of-property and confidentiality certification with DTSA notice and agency-reporting carve-outs is on file.
Visa-holder exits reach Immigration within 1 business day, so the LCA withdrawal, USCIS notice and return-fare offer (or the STEM OPT DSO report within 5 business days) happen on time.
controls.evidence: Immigration case system entry with dates

kpis.name: Final pay on time
kpis.why: CA waiting-time penalties reach 30 days' wages; India wage-authority claims and Taiwan fines follow late payment.

kpis.name: Access removed by end of last day
kpis.why: Main control against trade-secret exfiltration and SOX ITGC findings.

kpis.name: Regretted attrition rate (annualized)
kpis.target: At or below the plan target by function, e.g., <=6% in design engineering
kpis.why: Tells leadership whether critical chip-design talent is leaving.

kpis.name: 12-month retention of countered employees
kpis.why: Shows whether counteroffers buy real retention or only delay the exit.

kpis.name: Asset recovery within 10 business days
kpis.why: Unrecovered devices carry design data and controlled technology.

kpis.name: Exit survey response rate (voluntary leavers)
kpis.why: Without enough responses, attrition analysis and actions have no basis.

considerations: Don't reflexively accept a resignation 'effective immediately'. In California early release becomes a discharge with immediate final pay, and in Ontario waiving notice can be a dismissal. The default is to honour the notice or pay through it.

Counteroffer discipline: counter only for regretted, critical-skill employees, and don't match competitor equity dollar for dollar. Bengaluru VLSI and verification talent often receive counteroffers and notice buyouts from new employers, so decide fast and in writing.

Garden leave works in Canada (by contract or consent) and India (full pay during notice). In California it is lawful during notice but cannot be followed by any post-employment restraint. In Taiwan the employee stays employed and keeps accruing leave. China has no statutory garden leave, but the parties can agree an earlier release date, paid to that date.

Triage signals that should trigger ER-10: a direct competitor or PRC-linked destination; tapeout, RTL, PDK or customer-roadmap access; a DLP spike or personal-cloud uploads in the 30-90 days before notice; unusual after-hours repository cloning. For Taiwan leavers, add National Security Act core key technology reminders and any continuing mainland-travel approval duty for government-project staff.

Departing insiders stay bound by the insider trading policy while they hold MNPI. A Section 16 officer's resignation triggers an 8-K Item 5.02 within 4 business days of notice and final Form 4 activity, so route it to Legal the day notice is given.

The final-pay clock follows the work location, not HQ. A remote engineer in Colorado or Massachusetts has state-specific deadlines, and an India F&F that waits for clearance breaches the 2-working-day rule. Run clearance in parallel.
Never hold a relieving letter (India) or final pay (California LC 221) hostage to asset return or notice service. Pursue unreturned items through ER-10 and Legal.
Record both the employee-stated reason and the manager's view in separate fields. Overwriting one with the other corrupts regretted-attrition analytics and the 10-K human capital narrative.
Start knowledge transfer on day 1 of notice. Reassigning EDA licenses, foundry portal access and customer NDAs takes longer than document handover.

variations.when: Leaver is going to a direct competitor or PRC-linked company
variations.how: Garden leave where contractually available, access cut at notice, ER-10 forensic review and a Legal reminder letter. Taiwan leavers also get a National Security Act and Cross-Strait Act reminder. Non-competes are never threatened where void (CA, ON below C-suite, India).
Legal files Form 8-K Item 5.02 within 4 business days, informs the Comp Committee, confirms clawback-policy status and handles Form 4 reporting. Communications are sequenced with the filing.

variations.when: Visa holder (H-1B, L-1, O-1, STEM OPT)
variations.how: Immigration is notified the same day. For H-1B, the LCA is withdrawn, USCIS is notified and return transportation is offered, and the employee is told about the 60-day grace period. For STEM OPT, the DSO is notified within 5 business days and the final I-983 evaluation is submitted.

variations.when: Resignation while on leave or with an open complaint
variations.how: HRBP confirms voluntariness in writing and ER reviews the file. Constructive-dismissal risk is checked: China LCL Art. 38 and Taiwan LSA Art. 14 allow immediate resignation with severance for employer breaches.

variations.when: Employee withdraws the resignation before the effective date
variations.how: Accepted at company discretion under POL-52 (common in India). If the role is already backfilled, decline in writing; if accepted, reverse the Darwinbox transaction and cancel offboarding tasks.
Prepaid device return kit, video exit interview, and final pay under the work-location rules; California reimbursement duties (LC 2802) cover shipping.
China requires 3 days' notice in probation. India applies the contractual probation notice (often 7-30 days). Taiwan still applies the Art. 16 scale once tenure reaches 3 months.

countries.us: No statutory notice either way; two weeks is customary, and accepting a resignation early can start the state final-pay clock and, in some states (e.g., NY, IL), affect UI eligibility. Pay accrued vacation where state law requires it (CA, CO, IL, MA, NE), send the COBRA qualifying event to the administrator within 30 days plus the 402(f) rollover notice, and issue state separation notices where required (e.g., NY IA 12.3, NJ BC-10). For H-1B leavers, withdraw the LCA, notify USCIS and offer return transportation; for STEM OPT, notify the DSO within 5 business days. Non-competes are void in CA, MN, ND, OK and WY (WA from Jun 30, 2027), and enforcing an MA non-compete requires garden leave (50% of base) or other agreed consideration.
countries.us-ca: Final pay is due on the last day if the employee gave 72+ hours' notice, otherwise within 72 hours (mailed on request). If the company moves the date up, pay through the notice period or treat it as a discharge and pay immediately (LC 202; waiting-time penalty up to 30 days' wages under LC 203). Include accrued vacation/PTO (LC 227.3), meal/rest premiums, earned commissions and an itemized wage statement, and hand over the UI Code 1089 notice, DE 2320, HIPP and COBRA/Cal-COBRA notices. No non-compete or non-solicit may follow (B&P 16600/16600.5), no quit fees or repayment demands under agreements from 1 Jan 2026 (AB 692), and no withholding of pay for unreturned property (LC 221).
countries.ca: Neither the ON nor the BC ESA requires resignation notice; contracts usually set 2-4 weeks, and a resignation should be written and unequivocal. In ON, waiving the notice period early can amount to dismissal, so pay out at least the ESA-required portion; garden leave needs a contract term or the employee's consent. Final pay is due in ON by the later of 7 days or the next regular payday and in BC within 6 days after quitting, including vacation pay. File the electronic ROE within 5 calendar days after the end of the pay period with the interruption of earnings, using the correct reason code.
countries.in: The employee resigns under the contractual notice period (usually 60-90 days for engineers); the company may grant early release, accept a buyout (recovered only as the contract allows, within Code on Wages s.18 limits; no GST on notice-pay recovery) or use garden leave, but may not refuse the resignation indefinitely or withhold the relieving letter to coerce. F&F (salary, leave encashment and other 'wages') is due within 2 working days of the last working day (CoW s.17(2)), with clearance running in parallel, and gratuity (5+ years' service) within 30 days. Issue relieving and experience letters (Karnataka service certificate within 7 days of request), return original documents, and support Form 130 and PF transfer; post-exit non-competes are void (Contract Act s.27).
countries.tw: Employees on indefinite contracts resign with LSA Art. 16 notice (10/20/30 days by tenure); no employer acceptance is needed, and longer contractual notice periods or resignation penalties are generally unenforceable. Wages, overtime and unused annual leave are settled immediately on termination (Enforcement Rules Art. 9); withdraw Labor, EI, occupational accident insurance and NHI on the last day and report the pension stop within 7 days. Issue a service certificate on request with no unrequested adverse remarks (LSA Art. 19). A post-exit non-compete binds only if it meets Art. 9-1 (max 2 years, compensation of at least 50% of the average monthly wage); remind engineers of Trade Secrets Act and National Security Act duties.
countries.cn: The employee gives 30 days' written notice (3 days in probation) and the resignation takes effect without employer acceptance; the company can agree an earlier release date and pay to that date, but notice buyouts are not a statutory concept. Final wages, including untaken annual leave at 300%, are due in full at termination; there is no severance on ordinary resignation (LCL Art. 38 employer-breach resignations excepted). Issue the 离职证明 at termination, complete the personnel file and social insurance/housing fund transfer within 15 days (LCL Art. 50), and decide in writing whether to activate the non-compete (monthly compensation) or release it. Update SAFE Circular 7 for departing equity holders and keep exit documents at least 2 years.

processes.name: Involuntary termination
processes.summary: Governs employer-initiated individual exits (for cause, for performance, or without cause) from recommendation through risk review, approval, statutory pre-steps, the meeting, pay and close-out. Group position eliminations follow OF-03. Good looks like a documented lawful reason and a signed ER/Legal risk review for every case, approval per the authority matrix, final pay and documents ready at the meeting, access cut as the meeting starts, and no missed statutory step (China union notice, Taiwan Art. 33 notification, India enquiry, Canada entitlement calculation).
processes.owner: HRBP (process), Employee Relations (risk review and quality), Legal (approval for all non-US and high-risk US cases)
processes.trigger: Manager or ER recommends termination after corrective action or a PIP, an investigation finding, or a without-cause business decision affecting one role.
outputs: Pre-termination risk review (privileged where Legal directs), with comparator and protected-activity checks
Approval record per authority matrix
Termination packet: T-TERM-SCRIPT, termination letter (local language where required), T-SEP-TERMS separation terms
Statutory pre-step records (China union notice, Taiwan Art. 33 filing, India enquiry report, Canada entitlement calculation)
Access-removal log timestamped at the meeting; final pay proof
Darwinbox termination transaction with reason code and rehire eligibility
processes.sla: Recommendation to meeting: 5-10 business days in the US; 15-30+ days elsewhere to allow statutory steps (e.g., Taiwan 10-day Art. 33 notice); final pay at the meeting in California.

steps.label: Submit termination recommendation
steps.detail: Manager sends the HRBP the evidence file: PIP and check-in records (T-PIP), prior warnings (ER-04), the investigation report (ER-02) or the business rationale for a without-cause exit. Nothing is said to the employee or team before approval.

steps.label: Confirm category and evidence file
steps.detail: HRBP classifies the case as for cause, performance or without cause and checks the evidence against the local standard. US: at-will but documented. Canada: just cause is a high, proportionality-based bar. India: domestic enquiry for misconduct. China: Art. 39/40 grounds under rules adopted by democratic procedure. Taiwan: Art. 11/12 grounds with last-resort evidence. If the standard can't be met, the HRBP proposes a negotiated mutual separation instead.

steps.label: Run pre-termination risk review
steps.detail: ER completes the checklist: protected characteristics and comparator treatment; recent protected activity (complaints, hotline or SOX/Rule 21F reports, pay inquiries, Section 7 activity, workers' comp); leave status (FMLA/CFRA/PDL, maternity, China medical treatment period); accommodation requests; age 40+; visa status; open investigations. Ethics & Compliance confirms hotline history. In California, termination within 90 days of protected activity carries a retaliation presumption.
steps.control: The signed risk checklist is attached to the Darwinbox request, and the workflow blocks scheduling without it.

steps.label: Approve termination?
steps.detail: Legal reviews all non-US and high-risk US cases. Approval follows the authority matrix: Dept Head, CHRO for Director and above, Comp Committee for Section 16 officers. Legal approves, sends the case back to fix documentation gaps, or rejects it and returns it to coaching or the PIP.
steps.control: Authority-matrix approvals captured by e-signature before any notice.

steps.label: Complete statutory pre-steps
steps.detail: Before the meeting, complete the local pre-steps. China: written notice to the enterprise union (LCL Art. 43), with its response on file. Taiwan: Art. 33 notification 10 days before separation for Art. 11 exits, and Art. 12 action within 30 days of learning the facts. India: domestic enquiry report and Karnataka s.39 notice for 6+ months' service. Canada: entitlement calculation (ESA notice, ON severance, common-law exposure including bonus and equity) after Legal tests the termination clause.

steps.label: Prepare packet and meeting logistics
steps.detail: HRBP prepares the T-TERM-SCRIPT and the termination letter (in the local language where required; China and Taiwan letters cite the statutory ground). Add T-SEP-TERMS if severance is offered, plus a benefits/equity summary and EAP details. Schedule early in the week in a private room or on video, with an HRBP witness. Security attends only when an ER-07 threat assessment calls for it.

steps.label: Prepare final pay for the meeting
steps.detail: Payroll calculates final wages and payouts. For California (and CO/MA), the check or pre-authorized direct deposit, including accrued PTO, is ready at the meeting. Other deadlines: India F&F within 2 working days; BC within 48 hours; ON the later of 7 days or the next payday; Taiwan immediately, with severance within 30 days; China at termination.
steps.control: Maker-checker approval of final pay before the meeting.

steps.label: Disable access as meeting starts
steps.detail: At the agreed minute, IT runs the pre-staged ticket: SSO, VPN, email, Git/EDA and cloud accounts, plus lab and cleanroom badges. High-risk leavers' devices are preserved for imaging, not wiped. Remote employees get a prepaid return kit.
steps.control: Deprovisioning timestamp within 15 minutes of the meeting start; exceptions go to Security.

steps.label: Hold termination meeting
steps.detail: Manager follows the script and delivers the decision in under 15 minutes: a clear, truthful reason consistent with the file, no debate, full dignity. HRBP explains final pay, benefits end date, equity, the separation terms and review period, and collects the badge. The employee leaves with the letter and, in California, final pay.

steps.label: Signs separation terms?
steps.detail: Employee gets the full review period: OWBPA 21 days (45 for groups) plus 7-day revocation at age 40+; at least 5 business days in California; typically 5-10 business days in Canada and 3-7 days in India. Statutory amounts are paid whether or not the employee signs.

steps.label: Pay severance after revocation
steps.detail: Payroll pays severance and any COBRA subsidy only after the release is effective, with local tax treatment (US supplemental withholding, Canada retiring allowance, India TDS). Stock Admin applies any Legal-approved equity treatment.

steps.label: Issue documents, notify, close
steps.detail: HRBP issues the statutory documents: state separation notices; CA 1089 notice and DE 2320; ROE; relieving letter; Taiwan involuntary separation certificate and service certificate; China 离职证明, with social insurance transfer within 15 days. HRBP also sends a neutral team and customer handoff message and sets the rehire code. Section 16 and NEO exits go to Legal for Form 8-K Item 5.02 within 4 business days.

steps.label: Termination closed
steps.detail: Approvals, documents and payment proof are filed in Document management, and ER tracks any charge, claim or arbitration for 12 months.

steps.label: Not approved: back to PIP/ER-04
steps.detail: ER records the decision, and the manager continues coaching, the PIP or corrective action with HRBP support.

raci.A: Dept Head (CHRO for Director+; Comp Committee for Section 16 officers)

raci.activity: Statutory pre-steps (union notice, Art. 33, domestic enquiry, entitlement calculation)

controls.control: ER signs the pre-termination risk checklist (and Legal too for high-risk and non-US cases) before the meeting can be scheduled.
controls.evidence: Signed checklist in Case management linked to the Darwinbox request

controls.control: Authority-matrix approval is recorded before notice: Dept Head, CHRO for Director and above, Comp Committee/Board for Section 16 officers.
Statutory pre-steps are verified before the meeting: China union notice, Taiwan Art. 33 receipt, India enquiry report, Canada entitlement calculation reviewed by Legal.
controls.evidence: Copies in Document management referenced on the checklist

controls.control: A second reviewer approves final pay before the meeting; the California check or deposit is ready at the meeting.
controls.evidence: Payroll approval log and off-cycle ticket

controls.control: Access-removal time is reconciled against the meeting time, and any gap over 15 minutes is escalated.
controls.evidence: ITSM ticket timestamps and Security exception log

controls.control: Separation agreements come only from Legal-approved T-SEP-TERMS versions (OWBPA, Gov Code 12964.5, Rule 21F-17 and Section 7 carve-outs); any deviation needs Legal sign-off.
controls.evidence: Template version log and deviation approvals

controls.control: Each quarter, a privileged audit of involuntary terminations checks reason-code consistency, comparator treatment and protected-class distribution.

kpis.name: Risk review completed before notice
kpis.why: Pretext and retaliation claims turn on what was checked before the decision.

kpis.name: Final pay compliance
kpis.why: Waiting-time penalties and PAGA exposure in CA; statutory fines in India and Taiwan.

kpis.name: Access disabled within 15 minutes of meeting start
kpis.why: Protects design data and controlled technology at the highest-risk moment.

kpis.name: Claims or charges within 12 months
kpis.why: Direct measure of decision and process quality.

kpis.name: Release signature rate where severance offered
kpis.why: Unsigned releases leave litigation exposure open.

kpis.name: Cycle time recommendation to meeting (US)
kpis.why: Long delays after a decision raise leak, morale and retaliation-timing risk.

considerations: The reason in the script, the letter, the Darwinbox code, the UI response and any later agency position statement must match. Shifting reasons are the most common evidence of pretext.

Timing is evidence. A termination soon after a complaint, a leave return or an accommodation request needs proof that the decision came first, plus Legal sign-off. The California 90-day retaliation presumption makes this acute.

At-will does not travel. Canada, India, China and Taiwan each need statutory grounds and/or notice and pay. Never use a US script or letter abroad; in China, Taiwan and India, negotiated mutual separation is the practical default when evidence is borderline.

Canadian cost depends on clause enforceability. Before calculating notice, Legal tests the clause against Waksdale, Dufault v. Ignace (2024 ONCA 915; SCC leave denied 2025) and Baker v. Van Dolder's / Li v. Wayfair (2026 ONCA 568). If the clause fails, Bardal notice of up to about 24 months applies, including bonus and equity that would have vested (Matthews), so model the equity cost first.

The meeting: early in the week, private, under 15 minutes, HRBP as witness, never by text. For remote staff, use video with the letter emailed at the same time. A bad-faith manner of dismissal adds damages in Canada (Honda v. Keays).

For-cause cases need a completed investigation and a chance for the employee to respond. In China, work rules must have gone through democratic procedure and been acknowledged. Taiwan Art. 12 has a 30-day clock from learning the facts. India requires a natural-justice domestic enquiry.

Whistleblowers: run a SOX 806 and Dodd-Frank protected-activity check before any adverse action. Use a decision-maker independent of the complaint. Never condition severance on waiving SEC awards (Rule 21F-17; Foot Locker, May 2026).
Accelerating equity in a severance deal is a modification (ASC 718) and, for NEOs, can be an 8-K Item 5.02(e) event. Route it through Stock Admin and Legal, not as a manager promise.
Security presence should follow an ER-07 threat assessment, not habit. Needless escorts humiliate the employee and show up in litigation.

H-1B terminations are not bona fide until USCIS is notified, the LCA is withdrawn and return transportation is offered. Until then, back-wage liability continues. The worker gets a 60-day grace period.

variations.when: Employee is pregnant, on protected leave or in a protected period
variations.how: China Art. 42 bars Art. 40/41 terminations; Taiwan LSA Art. 13 bars termination during maternity leave and occupational-injury treatment; India bars dismissal during maternity leave; US FMLA/CFRA/PDL interference risk. Legal pre-approval is required, usually defer or use a negotiated mutual separation.

variations.when: US employee aged 40+ offered a release
variations.how: OWBPA terms: 21 days to consider and 7 to revoke, express ADEA reference, written advice to consult an attorney, and consideration beyond what is already owed.

Comp Committee or Board approval, the severance-plan or employment-agreement terms (including cure periods for 'cause'), 280G and clawback checks, Form 8-K Item 5.02 within 4 business days, and Form 4 coordination.

variations.when: Gross misconduct or workplace violence risk
variations.how: ER-07 threat assessment, suspension with pay pending the decision, Security at the meeting. Taiwan Art. 12 action within 30 days; China Art. 39 with a union notice record; Canada just-cause analysis before withholding ESA amounts (wilful misconduct only).

variations.when: Remote employee in another state or province
variations.how: Apply the work-location rules (e.g., CO immediate, MA same day, BC 48 hours), hold the meeting by video with the letter emailed simultaneously, and ship a prepaid return kit.
Independent review by Ethics & Compliance and Legal, a decision-maker with no involvement in the complaint, and a documented legitimate reason that predates the protected activity.

variations.when: Termination during or at the end of probation
variations.how: China: documented failure of criteria disclosed at hire. Taiwan: still needs an Art. 11 ground plus notice and pro-rated severance. ON/BC: no ESA notice before 3 months' service, but check the contract's probation clause. India: contractual probation notice.

countries.us: Employment is at-will (Montana requires good cause after probation), but the reason must be lawful. Check protected activity (complaints; FMLA, ADA or PWFA requests; SOX/Dodd-Frank whistleblowing; Section 7; workers' comp) and comparator treatment; EEOC charges can arrive 180/300 days later. Pay final wages by the work-state deadline (CO immediate; MA same day; CT next business day; TX 6 days; NY/IL/NJ/PA next regular payday), issue state separation/UI notices (e.g., NY IA 12.3, NJ BC-10) and send the COBRA event to the administrator within 30 days. Releases from employees 40+ need OWBPA terms, non-supervisory severance terms must respect McLaren Macomb and Rule 21F-17, and H-1B exits need USCIS notice, LCA withdrawal and a return-fare offer (60-day grace period).
countries.us-ca: All wages, including accrued vacation/PTO, premiums and commissions, are due immediately at termination (LC 201, 227.3); late pay triggers up to 30 days' waiting-time penalties (LC 203), so have the check or pre-authorized direct deposit ready at the meeting, including for remote terminations. Hand over the UI Code 1089 notice, DE 2320, HIPP notice and the COBRA/Cal-COBRA and LC 2800.2 notices. The main exposures are FEHA discrimination, retaliation and failure to accommodate, Tameny public-policy claims and whistleblower retaliation (presumption within 90 days of protected activity); document human review of any ADS input. Releases need a Civil Code 1542 waiver, the Gov Code 12964.5 carve-out and 5 business days to consult an attorney, and undisputed wages cannot be released (LC 206.5).
countries.ca: There is no at-will employment: a without-cause exit requires ESA notice or pay (ON and BC up to 8 weeks), plus ON ESA severance (1 week per year up to 26 weeks at 5+ years; the C$2.5M payroll test is always met), plus common-law Bardal notice unless an enforceable clause limits entitlement. Legal tests the clause first: under Waksdale one ESA breach voids every termination provision; Dufault v. Ignace (2024 ONCA 915; SCC leave denied June 2025) voided a clause over 'sole discretion ... at any time' wording; and Baker v. Van Dolder's / Li v. Wayfair (2026 ONCA 568) held 'at any time/for any reason' valid where the contract repeatedly guarantees ESA minimums. Just cause is a high proportionality bar (McKinley), and ON ESA amounts are forfeited only for wilful misconduct. Continue benefits through the ESA notice period, and pay final wages in ON by the later of 7 days or the next payday, in BC within 48 hours.
countries.in: There is no at-will employment: non-workers (managerial or administrative staff, supervisors above INR 18,000) can be exited by 'termination simpliciter' on contractual notice or pay in lieu with a non-stigmatic letter, subject to Karnataka Shops Act s.39 (reasonable cause and 1 month's notice after 6+ months' service; appealable). Misconduct dismissal requires a domestic enquiry that follows natural justice. 'Workers' (often individual-contributor engineers) can go straight to the Industrial Tribunal, where reinstatement with back wages is a remedy, so mutual separation with ex gratia and a release is the default for borderline cases. Pay F&F within 2 working days (CoW s.17(2)) and gratuity within 30 days; no dismissal during maternity leave, and no retaliation against POSH complainants or witnesses.
countries.tw: Termination is lawful only on an LSA Art. 11 ground (e.g., contraction or losses, business change with no suitable post, clear incompetence, after considering redeployment) or an Art. 12 summary ground invoked within 30 days of learning the facts (no notice or severance). Art. 11 exits need Art. 16 notice (10/20/30 days or pay in lieu, plus up to 2 days a week of paid job-seeking leave), new-system severance within 30 days (0.5 month's average wage per year, capped at 6 months) and the Employment Services Act Art. 33 notification 10 days before separation. Issue the involuntary separation certificate (EI benefits) and a service certificate on request (LSA Art. 19). An invalid dismissal leaves the contract in force with back pay, and labor courts can order continued employment during the case.
countries.cn: Terminate only on a statutory ground: Art. 39 fault (serious violation of lawfully adopted and communicated rules, fraud, etc.) needs no notice or severance, while Art. 40 no-fault (incompetence after training or reassignment, illness after the medical period, objective change after failed consultation) needs 30 days' notice or one month's pay in lieu plus N (the N+1 package). Before any unilateral termination, notify the enterprise union in writing (LCL Art. 43), respect Art. 42 protected categories (pregnancy, medical treatment period, work injury, 15+ years' service within 5 years of the rising retirement age), and deliver a Chinese-language notice citing the ground. Unlawful termination costs 2N or reinstatement with back pay, so most exits use an Art. 36 mutual termination recording that the employer proposed it (N floor; market N+1 to N+3), followed by the 离职证明 and social insurance transfer within 15 days.

processes.name: Reduction in force
processes.summary: Plans and executes group position eliminations across the US, Canada, India, Taiwan and China. Covers the business case, objective selection by decisional unit, privileged adverse-impact review, statutory notices and consultations, packages, and communications to leavers, survivors, customers and investors. Good looks like no missed notice clock, defensible selections with accurate OWBPA disclosures, packages paid on time, and a Disclosure Committee assessment of Form 8-K and MNPI before anyone is told.
processes.owner: CHRO (accountable), HRBP (execution), Legal (privilege, thresholds, notices), FP&A/Finance (business case and restructuring accounting)
processes.trigger: Leadership approves a cost, restructuring, program-cancellation or site action affecting multiple roles.
outputs: Approved business case and cost model, with restructuring accrual inputs (ASC 420/712)
T-RIF-SELECTION matrices per decisional unit and privileged adverse-impact memo

Statutory notices and filings: WARN/Cal-WARN, ON Form 1, BC group notice, India retrenchment notice and re-skilling fund transfer, China union explanation and labor-bureau report, Taiwan MRPA plan and Art. 33 notifications
Individual packets: T-SEP-TERMS, OWBPA group disclosure exhibit, final pay and severance calculations
Communications pack for leaders, leavers, survivors and customers, plus the Disclosure Committee's 8-K assessment
Post-RIF audit (payments, access, visas, filings, re-employment preference tracking)
processes.sla: Decision to notification: 6-10 weeks where only US WARN applies; 10-16+ weeks when ON/BC group notice, Taiwan's 60-day MRPA plan or China's 30-day union explanation applies.

steps.label: Approve RIF business case
steps.detail: CEO and CHRO approve the rationale (program cancellation, site consolidation, cost target) and a need-to-know planning team. The team goes on a project insider list, because a material RIF can be MNPI. The Comp Committee or Board is briefed when the action is material or affects officers.

steps.label: Model roles, costs and accruals
steps.detail: FP&A models positions by site and decisional unit, severance and notice costs (WARN pay in lieu, statutory amounts abroad), and restructuring accruals under ASC 420/712 with Finance. The Disclosure Committee assesses Form 8-K (e.g., Item 2.05 for material exit costs; verify with Securities counsel) and the 10-K/10-Q narrative.

steps.label: Map thresholds and notice clocks
steps.detail: Legal establishes privilege and maps each site against the thresholds: WARN (90-day aggregation), Cal-WARN (30 days), NY/NJ/IL/WA mini-WARN, ON (4 weeks) and BC (2 months) group rules, India retrenchment and Chapter X, China Art. 41 and Taiwan MRPA (60-day window). The longest clock sets the earliest separation date.
steps.control: Signed notice-plan memo per site before any selection is final.

steps.label: Define decisional units and criteria
steps.detail: HRBP and Legal fix the decisional units and objective, job-related criteria in T-RIF-SELECTION: go-forward skills, calibrated performance, certifications. Leave, complaints, age proxies and visa status are never criteria. Apply India LIFO within each category unless reasons are recorded, China Art. 41 priority-retention groups and Taiwan non-discrimination rules.

steps.label: Score and select with managers
steps.detail: Managers score every employee in the unit against the criteria with written rationale, and the HRBP calibrates across managers. Everyone selected is screened for protected situations: leave, pregnancy/maternity, China medical treatment period and near-retirement protection, work injury, pending complaints.
steps.control: Protected-status screen logged for every selected employee.

steps.label: Run privileged adverse-impact test
steps.detail: At Legal's direction, HR Analytics compares selection rates within each decisional unit by age 40+, sex, race/ethnicity and national origin (plus FEHA categories in California), using the 4/5ths rule and significance tests. Results go only to Legal, labelled privileged.

steps.label: Adverse impact or risk found?
steps.detail: Legal reviews the results and individual risk cases. An unexplained disparity sends the unit back for re-scoring or a criteria review, never for demographic balancing.
steps.control: Adverse-impact sign-off before the list is final.

steps.label: Assess visa-holder impact
steps.detail: Immigration lists affected H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN and STEM OPT holders and pending PERM/I-140 cases. It plans bona fide termination steps (USCIS notice, LCA withdrawal, return-fare offer) and the 60-day grace period. It also times the RIF against pending H-1B filings, because the Sept 18, 2026 EO directs agencies to weigh past-year and planned layoffs. Work-permit holders in Canada and Taiwan are flagged too.

steps.label: File notices; consult unions
steps.detail: Legal issues each notice: WARN/Cal-WARN (employees, state agency/EDD, workforce board, local officials; SB 617 content); ON Form 1 to the Director, plus posting; BC notice to employees, any union and the Minister; India retrenchment notice to the government; China 30-day explanation to the union or all employees, then the labor-bureau report (Shanghai: worker-representative notice 30 days before filing); Taiwan MRPA plan 60 days ahead, negotiation within 10 days, and Art. 33 notifications.
steps.control: Filing receipts retained per site.

steps.label: Calculate packages and final pay
steps.detail: Payroll and Total Rewards compute statutory and enhanced amounts per person and each final-pay deadline. Examples: India 15 days' pay per year plus the re-skilling fund transfer within 10 days; Taiwan severance within 30 days; China N; ON ESA severance. Legal attaches the OWBPA exhibit (decisional unit, eligibility factors, job titles and ages of those selected and not selected) reconciled to HRIS.
steps.control: A second reviewer reconciles the OWBPA exhibit to HRIS.

steps.label: Brief managers; notify employees
steps.detail: Managers are trained on the T-TERM-SCRIPT the day before. Notifications happen 1:1 or in small groups within one window per site. Each packet includes T-SEP-TERMS and, for US employees 40+, the 45/7-day review terms. Access changes are timed with IT, and EAP and outplacement are on site. Employees serving WARN or ON notice periods move to garden leave with pay and benefits continuing.

steps.label: Communicate to org and market
steps.detail: CHRO and CEO hold the all-hands and survivor briefing within hours of notification, timed with any 8-K or press release and Regulation FD. Customer-facing teams get handoff scripts. Insider-list restrictions lift only after public disclosure.

steps.label: Pay packages; process exits
steps.detail: Payroll pays final wages by each deadline (California: immediately on the separation date) and severance once releases are effective. Stock Admin applies plan vesting treatment, and Benefits issues COBRA subsidies and continuation notices. Statutory documents (ROE, relieving letters, 离职证明, involuntary separation certificates) follow OF-05.

steps.label: Support survivors; audit the RIF
steps.detail: Managers hold survivor 1:1s within a week, re-scope work and confirm retention actions for critical talent. Within 30 days, HRBP and Legal audit payments, access removal, filings, visa actions and re-employment preference tracking (India 1 year; China 6 months).
steps.control: Post-RIF audit report within 30 days.

steps.label: RIF closed; audit filed
steps.detail: CHRO signs off the audit and lessons learned, and FP&A reconciles the restructuring accrual to actual payments.

controls.control: Legal checks each site's thresholds and notice clocks, including aggregation windows (WARN 90 days, Cal-WARN 30 days, ON 4 weeks, BC 2 months, Taiwan 60 days), and signs off before any notification.
The adverse-impact analysis is completed and cleared under privilege before selections are final.
controls.evidence: Privileged analysis memo with Legal sign-off

controls.control: A second reviewer reconciles the OWBPA disclosure exhibit to HRIS data (decisional unit, ages, titles, selected/not selected).
MNPI controls: the planning team is on the insider list and restricted from trading until disclosure, and the Disclosure Committee documents its 8-K assessment.
controls.evidence: Insider list and Disclosure Committee minutes

controls.control: Restructuring accruals (ASC 420/712) are reconciled to actual severance payments each quarter.
A protected-status screen (leave, maternity, China medical period and near-retirement, work injury, open complaints) is run before the list is final.
A post-RIF audit within 30 days confirms final-pay timeliness, access removal, visa actions and statutory filing receipts.

kpis.name: Statutory notices and filings on time
kpis.why: Missed WARN/Form 1/MRPA clocks create back-pay liability, fines or invalid notices.

kpis.name: Final pay and severance by legal deadline
kpis.why: Waiting-time penalties (CA), wage claims (India) and fines (Taiwan, China).

kpis.name: Release execution rate
kpis.why: Measures package adequacy and closes claim exposure.

kpis.name: Unresolved adverse-impact findings at notification
kpis.why: Selection must be defensible before anyone is told.

kpis.name: Regretted attrition among survivors, 6 months post-RIF
kpis.why: Measures whether the RIF destroyed the capability it meant to protect.

kpis.name: Claims or charges from affected employees
kpis.why: Tests whether selection and process quality held up.

considerations: Decisional-unit design drives both the OWBPA disclosures and the adverse-impact results. Fix the units before scoring and don't redraw them after seeing results.
Criteria must be objective and forward-looking (skills the retained roadmap needs). Thinly calibrated 'low performer' labels and cost-based selection by salary often correlate with age, so test them.
Privilege is fragile. HR Analytics works at Legal's direction, drafts stay out of general email and Slack, and managers see only their own unit's scoring.

Notice clocks stack. ON notice isn't effective until the Director receives Form 1. China needs 30 days' union explanation before the labor-bureau report. Taiwan needs a 60-day plan plus negotiation within 10 days. Set one global announcement date by the longest clock, or use pay in lieu where the law allows (US WARN, ON individual notice).

A material RIF can be MNPI. Keep the planning team on the insider list, pre-clear any trading, and have the Disclosure Committee decide on 8-K treatment (Item 2.05 for material exit costs, verify; Item 5.02 for officer departures) before internal leaks force the timing.

H-1B: the Sept 18, 2026 EO makes past-year and planned layoffs a factor in H-1B and LCA adjudication. Sequence pending petitions with Immigration counsel, and complete bona fide termination steps for every affected H-1B holder.

India: classify each person as worker or non-worker by dominant duties, not title. Workers get 1 month's notice, 15 days' pay per year and the re-skilling fund contribution. Chapter X prior permission applies only to factories, mines and plantations with 300+ workers, but check whether any validation lab is registered as a factory. Never run a US-style same-day exit.

China: most MNCs run a voluntary mutual-termination program at N+1 to N+3 instead of an Art. 41 layoff, but they still notify the union and keep priority groups off the list. Shanghai's 2026 layoff-reporting rule adds a 30-day worker-representative step.
Survivors decide whether the RIF works. Explain the why and the go-forward plan within 24 hours, reassign orphaned work explicitly, and use targeted retention RSUs for critical skills.
Canada: common-law notice includes bonus and equity that would vest during the notice period unless plan wording clearly excludes it (Matthews), so model it in the business case.

variations.how: US WARN plant closing (50+ at a single site) or Cal-WARN termination; the ON 10% exception does not apply to a permanent closure; China Art. 41 or a mutual-termination program; India closure of an industrial establishment with 50+ workers needs 60 days' notice.
Individual process per country (OF-02). If two or more US employees aged 40+ are offered releases under the program, it is still a group program: 45/7 days and the decisional-unit disclosure apply.

Offer voluntary packages before involuntary selection (China mutual termination; Taiwan mutual separation with the involuntary reason code so employees can claim EI benefits). OWBPA 45/7 and disclosures still apply to US voluntary programs.
WARN attributes remote employees to the site they report to; NJ counts employees reporting to NJ sites; final pay follows each employee's work state or province.

variations.when: Union, works committee or GRC present
variations.how: Consult under any collective agreement. BC notice goes to the union. India: notify the recognised union and GRC where relevant. China: union explanation and opinion record.

Submit the MRPA plan to the authority and the union or labor representatives and post it 60 days ahead; negotiate within 10 days or face an authority-convened committee; pay severance promptly, because responsible persons can face exit bans.
Comp Committee approval, severance-plan terms, 280G review if change-in-control-related, and Form 8-K Item 5.02 within 4 business days.

countries.us: Federal WARN (100+ employees) requires 60 days' notice to employees, the state dislocated-worker unit and local government for a plant closing (50+ job losses at a site) or a mass layoff (500+, or 50-499 if at least 33% of the site), aggregated over 90 days; remote employees count at their reporting site. State mini-WARN laws are stricter: NY 90 days at 25+ losses (the form asks about AI/automation), NJ 90 days plus 1 week's severance per year of service, IL 75+ employees and 60 days, WA 60 days. Group releases from employees 40+ need 45 days to consider, 7 to revoke and a written disclosure of the decisional unit, eligibility factors, and job titles and ages of those selected and not selected. For H-1B holders, complete bona fide termination (60-day grace period); the Sept 18, 2026 EO directs agencies to weigh the layoffs in H-1B and LCA adjudication.
countries.us-ca: Cal-WARN covers establishments with 75+ employees in the prior 12 months and requires 60 days' notice of a mass layoff (50+ within 30 days, regardless of percentage), a relocation of 100+ miles or a termination. Notice goes to employees, EDD, the Local Workforce Development Board and city and county chief elected officials, with SB 617 content from 2026 (rapid-response coordination, board contacts, CalFresh). Violations cost up to 60 days' back pay and benefits plus a $500/day civil penalty. Final pay including accrued PTO is due immediately on the separation date (LC 201, 203); the adverse-impact review covers FEHA categories, and releases need Civil Code 1542, the Gov Code 12964.5 carve-out and OWBPA 45/7 disclosures.
countries.ca: ON mass termination (50+ employees at an establishment within 4 weeks) requires 8, 12 or 16 weeks' notice (50-199, 200-499, 500+), with Form 1 filed with the Director (notice is not effective until received) and posted, and employees get 3 unpaid job-seeking days during notice (since Nov 27, 2025). ESA severance still applies; the exception is 10% or less of the workforce, not caused by a permanent closure. BC group termination (50+ at a single location within 2 months) requires 8, 12 or 16 weeks' notice (50-100, 101-300, 301+) to each employee, any union and the Minister of Labour, on top of individual CLOS. Common-law notice (including bonus and equity during it) applies to every employee unless an enforceable clause limits it; issue ROEs within 5 calendar days after the pay-period end.
countries.in: Retrenching 'workers' with 1+ year's service requires 1 month's written notice with reasons (or pay in lieu), compensation of 15 days' average pay per completed year, notice to the appropriate government, LIFO within each category unless reasons are recorded, and 1 year's re-employment preference. The employer also pays 15 days' last-drawn wages into the Worker Re-skilling Fund within 10 days (IR Code ss.70-72, 83). Chapter X prior government permission applies only to factories, mines and plantations with 300+ workers, so a pure design office generally needs none (check any lab registered as a factory). Managers are exited contractually through negotiated packages; everyone gets F&F within 2 working days and gratuity within 30 days, and large Bengaluru layoffs draw labour-department and union scrutiny.
countries.tw: Individual redundancy uses LSA Art. 11(2) or (4), with Art. 16 notice, severance (0.5 month's average wage per year, capped at 6 months, within 30 days) and the Employment Services Act Art. 33 notification to the authority 10 days before separation. The Mass Redundancy Protection Act applies when, within a 60-day window, layoffs at a site exceed: 10 (sites under 30 staff); 1/3 or 20 in one day (30-199); 1/4 or 50 in one day (200-499); 1/5 or 80 in one day (500+); or 200 (or 100 in a day) enterprise-wide (verify thresholds against the current Act). The plan then goes to the labor authority and the union (or labor-management-meeting representatives, or all employees) and is posted 60 days ahead, with negotiation within 10 days. Issue involuntary separation certificates; unpaid statutory wages or severance can lead to exit bans for responsible persons.
countries.cn: An economic layoff under LCL Art. 41 (20+ employees, or fewer than 20 but 10%+ of the workforce) is limited to bankruptcy reorganization, serious operating difficulty, production change or major technical innovation, or another major objective change. Explain the plan to the union or all employees 30 days in advance, consider their opinions, and report to the labor bureau (Shanghai from Aug 2026: notify worker representatives 30 days before filing under 沪人社规〔2026〕14号). Retain priority groups (long fixed-term or open-ended contracts, sole earners supporting elderly or minor dependants), respect Art. 42 protected categories, pay N, and rehire laid-off staff first within 6 months. In practice MNCs run voluntary mutual-termination programs (N+1 to N+3) to avoid Art. 41 scrutiny, then issue the 离职证明 and transfer social insurance within 15 days.

processes.name: Separation agreements & releases
processes.summary: Drafts, approves, delivers and administers separation agreements that exchange consideration beyond what is already owed for a release, using country templates with the required protected-rights carve-outs. Good looks like only Legal-approved templates in use, correct consideration and revocation periods, statutory amounts never conditioned on signature, and payment only after the release is effective.
processes.trigger: Any exit where the company offers severance, ex gratia or enhanced terms (OF-02, OF-03, negotiated mutual separation, executive exit).
outputs: Executed agreement from the current T-SEP-TERMS country version (bilingual where required)
Review/revocation period log with confirmed effective date
Payment instruction released after the effective date
Deviation approval record
processes.sla: Draft within 2 business days of package approval; payment within one payroll cycle after the release effective date.

steps.label: Request agreement with approved terms
steps.detail: HRBP sends Legal the approved package (severance, benefits subsidy, bonus and equity treatment, reference and announcement terms) with the exit type, country, age and role. Approval follows the authority matrix before any figure is shared with the employee.

steps.label: Draft from country template
steps.detail: Legal drafts from the current T-SEP-TERMS version. The core: general release; Section 7, Rule 21F-17 and agency-reporting carve-outs; return of property; confidentiality limited to agreement terms and trade secrets; cooperation. Local elements: OWBPA, Civil Code 1542, Gov Code 12964.5, Canada retiring allowance, China Art. 36 mutual termination, Taiwan bilingual itemization.
steps.control: Only current template versions; text outside variable fields is locked in the e-signature library.

steps.label: Deliver with review period
steps.detail: HRBP delivers the agreement with a cover letter that itemizes the statutory amounts paid regardless and states the review period: OWBPA 21/45 days; CA 5 business days; typically 5-10 business days in Canada and 3-7 days in India. The letter recommends independent advice, and no one pressures the employee to sign at the meeting.

steps.label: Requests changes?
steps.detail: The employee or their counsel may ask for changes; HRBP logs the request and forwards it to Legal.

steps.label: Review and approve deviations
steps.detail: Legal approves, rejects or counters within its delegated authority (CHRO for amounts above the matrix). Under OWBPA, changes do not restart the 21/45-day period if the parties agree, so record that agreement.

steps.label: Sign; revocation period runs
steps.detail: The employee signs on or after the separation date so the release covers the whole employment. Any 7-day OWBPA revocation period runs from signature, and the HRBP records the effective date on the payroll ticket.

steps.label: Pay after effective date
steps.detail: Payroll pays within one payroll cycle after the effective date, with local tax treatment. For US executives, Legal checks 409A timing where the review window spans two tax years.
steps.control: Payment released only against a confirmed effective date with no revocation.

steps.label: File executed agreement
steps.detail: The executed agreement, deviation approvals and payment proof are filed in Document management. Executive agreements are prepared on the assumption they will be filed publicly (8-K Item 5.02(e) or periodic-report exhibit).

controls.control: Only the current Legal-approved template version is used; the e-signature library locks text outside variable fields.
controls.evidence: Template version log and e-signature library configuration

controls.control: Severance is released only after the review and revocation periods have lapsed with no revocation, confirmed in the payroll ticket.
An annual audit checks all templates and legacy agreements still in force for Rule 21F-17, McLaren Macomb, Speak Out Act and Gov Code 12964.5 compliance.

kpis.name: Agreements without unapproved deviation
kpis.why: Unvetted edits are where 21F-17 and NLRA violations creep in.

kpis.name: Severance paid within one payroll cycle of effective date
kpis.why: Late consideration invites repudiation arguments and complaints.

kpis.name: Signature rate where offered
kpis.why: Shows whether packages and delivery are calibrated.

considerations: Never condition statutory entitlements on signature: final wages and accrued vacation, ESA notice and severance, India F&F and gratuity, Taiwan statutory severance. Consideration must be something extra.

Carve-outs are non-negotiable. No waiver of SEC or other government awards and no prior notice to the company before contacting regulators (Rule 21F-17; the SEC fined Foot Locker $148,000 in May 2026 for award waivers). Section 7 rights for non-supervisory employees (McLaren Macomb). Speak Out Act. Gov Code 12964.5 language in California.
Have the employee sign on or after the last day so the release covers the whole employment. In California, never try to release undisputed wages (LC 206.5).
Draft executive agreements as if they will be filed publicly. Check 409A payment timing, 280G and clawback-policy acknowledgments.
China and Taiwan agreements need Chinese text that controls, or at least a bilingual version, and Quebec needs a French transaction. A mistranslated release is a weak release.

variations.how: OWBPA: plain language, express ADEA reference, written advice to consult an attorney, 21 days (45 for groups, with decisional-unit disclosures) and 7 days to revoke.
Severance-plan or employment-agreement terms, Comp Committee approval, Form 8-K Item 5.02 (and 5.02(e) for material amendments), clawback-policy acknowledgment.

variations.when: Employee has a pending charge, claim or lawsuit
variations.how: Legal handles it as a settlement. EEOC charge filing cannot be waived (monetary recovery can). CA CCP 1001 bars confidentiality of facts in filed sexual harassment or discrimination claims, and CCP 1002.5 bars no-rehire clauses for good-faith claimants.

China: record that the employer proposed the termination (N floor). Taiwan: record the involuntary reason code so the employee can claim EI benefits. Consider recording the settlement in labor mediation for finality.

countries.us: A release must be knowing and voluntary and supported by new consideration: for employees 40+, OWBPA requires 21 days (45 for groups, with disclosures), 7 days to revoke, an ADEA reference and advice to consult an attorney, and FLSA wage claims generally cannot be released privately. Carve out non-releasable rights (EEOC/NLRB charges, SEC awards, UI, workers' comp, vested ERISA benefits), keep confidentiality and non-disparagement for non-supervisory employees within McLaren Macomb limits, and note that the Speak Out Act voids pre-dispute NDAs for sexual assault and harassment while NY/NJ/IL/WA restrict confidentiality of discrimination facts.
countries.us-ca: Include an express Civil Code 1542 waiver of unknown claims, the Gov Code 12964.5 (SB 331) carve-out ('Nothing in this agreement prevents you from discussing or disclosing information about unlawful acts in the workplace...'), notice of the right to consult an attorney and at least 5 business days to consider. Undisputed wages cannot be released (LC 206.5); LC 2802 reimbursement, workers' comp and representative PAGA claims are not waivable; CCP 1001 bars confidentiality of facts in filed sexual harassment or discrimination claims; and CCP 1002.5 bars no-rehire clauses for good-faith claimants.
countries.ca: Consideration must exceed ESA minimums, which are paid regardless and cannot be conditioned on signing; give reasonable time (5-10 business days is standard) and recommend independent legal advice, because courts set aside unconscionable releases. Structure lump sums as retiring allowances (withholding at 10%, 20% or 30% by amount outside Quebec), and use a French transaction under the Civil Code for Quebec employees.
countries.in: An agreement is enforceable if voluntary and supported by consideration beyond statutory dues (F&F wages, leave encashment, gratuity, PF, retrenchment compensation for workers), which are paid in full and never tied to signing. Give 3-7 days, advise the employee to take advice, and state gross and net amounts and tax treatment; for 'workers', a settlement reached in conciliation binds more firmly than a private one.
countries.tw: Settlement agreements (Civil Code Art. 736) are enforceable if voluntary and informed: accrued claims can be settled, but mandatory-law rights cannot be waived in advance, and fraud or duress allows rescission (Civil Code Art. 92). Use bilingual text itemizing statutory notice pay, severance and unused leave plus the ex gratia amount, and state the reason code for EI benefits.
countries.cn: Use an LCL Art. 36 mutual termination agreement (Chinese or bilingual, Chinese prevailing) that records the employer proposed the termination (N floor), the full release, social insurance and housing fund handling, the non-compete activation or release, confidentiality and the payment schedule. SPC Interpretation (I) Art. 35 upholds such settlements absent fraud, coercion, material misunderstanding or obvious unfairness, but waivers of social insurance or mandatory work-injury rights are void (Interpretation II Art. 19).

processes.name: Final pay, benefits & equity at exit
processes.summary: Makes sure every leaver receives correct final wages, PTO or leave payout, statutory amounts, benefits-continuation notices, equity treatment and tax/social documents within each jurisdiction's deadline. Good looks like 100% on-time payment, no unlawful deductions, HRIS and equity-platform termination dates that match, and every statutory document issued.
processes.owner: Payroll (accountable), Benefits and Stock Admin (notices and equity), People Ops (trigger and documents)
processes.trigger: Termination transaction approved in Darwinbox (any exit type).
outputs: Final pay calculation and itemized wage statement
PTO/leave payout per jurisdiction
Benefits end date and continuation/conversion notices
Equity termination statement (forfeiture, exercise deadlines, ESPP refund)
Statutory exit documents (e.g., ROE, CA 1089 notice, India Form 130 and PF exit, Taiwan insurance withdrawal, China social insurance transfer)
processes.sla: Per jurisdiction: CA immediate on discharge (72 hours on resignation without notice); India 2 working days; BC 48 hours (terminated) or 6 days (quit); ON later of 7 days or next payday; Taiwan immediate; China at termination.

steps.label: Termination approved in HRIS
steps.detail: The approved Darwinbox termination (exit type, last day, work location, notice given) calculates the final-pay deadline and creates Payroll, Benefits and Stock Admin tasks.

steps.label: Calculate final pay and payouts
steps.detail: Payroll computes wages to the last day, overtime and premiums, earned commissions under the written plan, required PTO/leave payout, notice pay and statutory severance. Deductions are taken only where lawful: none for unreturned property in California, and India deductions only within Code on Wages limits.
steps.control: Maker-checker review of every final pay calculation.

steps.label: Deadline before next payroll?
steps.detail: Payroll compares the statutory deadline with the entity's next scheduled payroll date.

steps.label: Run off-cycle payment
steps.detail: Payroll issues an off-cycle check or pre-authorized direct deposit by the deadline, e.g., at the meeting in California or within 2 working days in India.

steps.label: Include in regular payroll
steps.detail: Final pay runs in the regular cycle only where that meets the deadline (e.g., ON next regular payday within the 7-day rule).

steps.label: End coverage; send notices
steps.detail: Benefits sets coverage end dates and sends the COBRA qualifying event to the administrator within 30 days. It also issues conversion/portability, FSA run-out, HSA and 402(f) information. Outside the US, it processes insurance withdrawals and any continued medical cover in the package.

steps.label: Process equity at termination
steps.detail: Stock Admin records forfeiture of unvested awards on the HRIS termination date and confirms each vested option's exercise deadline. It processes ESPP withdrawal and refund per plan, updates China SAFE Circular 7 registration, and sends the exit statement to the personal email on file.
steps.control: Monthly HRIS-to-equity-platform termination reconciliation.

steps.label: Issue statutory exit documents
steps.detail: People Ops issues the country documents (e.g., CA 1089/DE 2320, ROE, India Form 130 and PF exit, Taiwan insurance withdrawals, China social insurance transfer) and files proof of payment.

steps.label: Receives final pay and documents
steps.detail: The employee has the final wage statement, benefits and equity statements and statutory documents, plus a named contact for questions.

controls.control: Darwinbox auto-calculates the deadline from work location and exit type, and auto-creates an off-cycle ticket when the deadline falls before the next payroll.
controls.evidence: Darwinbox deadline field and off-cycle ticket

controls.control: A second reviewer checks final pay, including PTO payout and any deductions, before release.
A monthly reconciliation compares HRIS terminations with equity-platform forfeitures and benefits terminations (stock-based compensation, SOX).

kpis.name: Final pay on time
kpis.why: Penalties accrue daily in CA and by fine in India, Taiwan and China.

kpis.name: Final pay corrections after release
kpis.why: Measures calculation quality and PTO/commission accuracy.

kpis.name: HRIS vs equity termination-date mismatches at month-end
kpis.why: Mismatches misstate stock-based compensation expense.

considerations: The deadline follows the work location and the exit type. A remote engineer in Colorado (immediate on involuntary exit) or Massachusetts (same day) is not on HQ rules.

Commissions and bonuses are paid per the written plan (California requires written commission plans). In Canada, bonus earned during the common-law notice period is owed unless plan wording clearly excludes it.

The equity exit statement must list the vest-stop date, each option's exercise deadline (ISO status lapses after 3 months), ESPP refund handling, and the reminder that insider-trading rules still apply while the person holds MNPI. It also covers India TDS on any post-exit vesting and China SAFE repatriation.
Don't make final pay conditional on clearance or asset return. India's 2-working-day rule and California LC 221 both prohibit it in effect.
Group life and disability conversion windows are short (check each carrier's contract), so send them with the final pay, not weeks later.

variations.how: Pay to the estate or lawful survivor under OF-09 rules; stop direct deposit to the deceased's account.

variations.when: Employee on disability leave at exit
variations.how: Coordinate STD/LTD claim continuity with the carrier. In Canada, continue benefits through the ESA notice period and watch LTD exposure during common-law notice.
ON ESA severance may be paid over up to 3 years only with written agreement or Director approval; US instalments need a 409A review.

countries.us: There is no federal final-pay deadline, so state law controls: CO immediate on involuntary exit (penalty the greater of 2x or $1,000), MA same day on involuntary exit (treble damages), TX 6 days, NY/IL/NJ/PA next payday, MN within 24 hours of demand. Pay out PTO where required (CA, CO, IL, MA, NE), send the COBRA event within 30 days (election notice within 44 days if employer-administered) plus the 402(f) notice, and state that ISOs must be exercised within 3 months to keep ISO status.
countries.us-ca: On discharge or layoff, all wages, accrued vacation/PTO and meal/rest premiums are due immediately; on resignation, they are due on the last day with 72+ hours' notice, otherwise within 72 hours (LC 201-203; up to 30 days' wages in waiting-time penalties), and direct deposit requires prior authorization. Give the itemized wage statement (LC 226), UI Code 1089 notice, DE 2320, HIPP and COBRA/Cal-COBRA/LC 2800.2 notices; forfeiting unvested equity is allowed, but clawing back paid or vested amounts can run into AB 692.
countries.ca: ON: wages, vacation pay, termination pay and severance by the later of 7 days or the next regular payday (severance in instalments over up to 3 years only with written agreement or Director approval); BC: within 48 hours if the employer terminates, 6 days if the employee quits. Continue benefits through the ON ESA notice period, file the ROE within 5 calendar days after the pay-period end, issue the T4 by end of February, and confirm equity forfeiture wording excludes the common-law notice period (Matthews).
countries.in: Wages including leave encashment are due within 2 working days of the last day (Code on Wages s.17(2); fines up to INR 50,000 for a first offence), and gratuity within 30 days of becoming payable (5 years' service, 1 year for fixed-term; INR 20 lakh ceiling), with interest if late. Issue Form 130 and Form 123 where applicable, update the EPFO exit date and support PF transfer; TDS applies to any post-exit RSU vesting.
countries.tw: Wages, overtime and unused annual leave are settled immediately on termination (Enforcement Rules Art. 9) and severance within 30 days (fines of NT$300,000-1,500,000 if unpaid); withdraw Labor/EI/occupational accident insurance and NHI on the last day and report the pension stop within 7 days. Unvested US RSUs usually lapse under plan terms; departed employees go into the January withholding filing, and foreign residents need departure tax clearance.
countries.cn: Final wages, including untaken annual leave at 300%, are due in full at termination (verify any short local grace period in Shenzhen), and economic compensation is payable when the handover is complete (LCL Art. 50), with the labor bureau able to order an additional 50-100% on unpaid amounts (LCL Art. 85). Transfer or suspend social insurance and housing fund within 15 days, and update SAFE Circular 7 so post-exit equity proceeds can be repatriated and taxed.

processes.name: Access removal & asset recovery
processes.summary: Removes all logical and physical access and recovers company assets for every leaver on a timed schedule: at the meeting for involuntary and high-risk exits, at the end of the last day otherwise. Each step is documented for SOX ITGC, export-control and trade-secret purposes. Good looks like 100% of accounts disabled on schedule, devices recovered within 10 business days, a signed return certification, and lawful handling of unreturned equipment.
processes.owner: IT (execution), Security (timing and high-risk cases), People Ops (trigger)
processes.trigger: Darwinbox termination transaction with a scheduled cut time, or an immediate-cut request from HRBP or Security.
outputs: Deprovisioning ticket with per-system timestamps (SSO, VPN, email, Git/EDA, cloud, foundry/customer portals, badges)
Asset return record (laptop, tokens, dev boards, samples, lab notebooks, badges)
Signed return-of-property and data-deletion certification
Export-control access closure and licence-proviso report where required
Weekly HRIS-to-identity reconciliation
processes.sla: Involuntary or high-risk: disabled at meeting start or at notice; voluntary: by end of last working day; devices recovered within 10 business days.

steps.label: Termination scheduled in HRIS
steps.detail: The Darwinbox termination creates a timed deprovisioning ticket in the ITSM tool, carrying the last day, the cut time and risk flags from HRBP or Security.

steps.label: Immediate cut required?
steps.detail: An immediate cut applies to involuntary exits, RIF notifications, gross misconduct, and high-risk voluntary exits (competitor or PRC-linked destination, DLP alerts, TCP-controlled access).

steps.label: Disable access at meeting or notice
steps.detail: IT disables SSO, VPN, email, Git/EDA, cloud consoles and foundry and customer portals at the meeting start or at notice. It rotates shared secrets and preserves the devices for imaging.

steps.label: Disable access end of last day
steps.detail: IT disables all accounts at the scheduled time on the last working day, sets a neutral auto-reply, and delegates mailbox and file ownership to the manager under legal-hold rules.

steps.label: Deactivate badges; clear lab access
steps.detail: Facilities deactivates building, lab and cleanroom badges, recovers keys, lockers and parking, and collects dev boards, samples and lab notebooks. EHS confirms any assigned hazardous materials or lasers are logged back in.

steps.label: Return devices; sign certification
steps.detail: The employee returns laptop, phones, tokens and media in person or via a prepaid return kit (employer pays shipping; CA LC 2802). They sign the return and data-deletion certification, which preserves agency-reporting rights.

steps.label: Close export-control records
steps.detail: Trade Compliance updates the technology control plan register and deemed-export license records, and files any licence-proviso report required when a licensed foreign national leaves.

steps.label: Reconcile and chase gaps
steps.detail: Security runs the weekly HRIS-to-identity reconciliation and closes orphan accounts within 24 hours. It pursues unreturned assets through reminder letters and Legal, never through final-pay deductions in California.
steps.control: Weekly reconciliation report (SOX ITGC).

steps.label: Access closed; ticket resolved
steps.detail: IT closes the ticket with all timestamps and the asset list, and preserved devices stay in chain-of-custody storage until Legal releases them.

controls.control: Each week, Darwinbox terminations are reconciled against Okta/AD, VPN and EDA license accounts, and exceptions are closed within 24 hours.
The HRIS auto-generates a timed deprovisioning ticket; the immediate-cut option requires Security confirmation.
High-risk leavers' devices are preserved, not wiped, until Legal and Security release them.
Export-control access closure and any licence-proviso reporting are completed within 1 business day of exit.
controls.evidence: TCP register update and filed report

kpis.name: Accounts disabled on schedule
kpis.why: Orphan accounts are a top SOX ITGC finding and an exfiltration path.

kpis.name: Devices recovered within 10 business days
