kpis.why: Unrecovered laptops carry design data and controlled technology.

kpis.name: Orphan accounts older than 24 hours
kpis.why: Tests the reconciliation control.

considerations: Don't wipe a high-risk leaver's laptop before forensic imaging. Evidence of exfiltration is often only on the device.

BYOD: selectively wipe the corporate container via MDM and cover it in the privacy notice. That means separate PIPL consent where sensitive data is involved in China, DPDP s.7(i) legitimate use in India, and PDPA disclosure in Taiwan.

Look beyond SSO. Shared service accounts, code-signing keys, EDA license servers, foundry and PDK portals, and customer or partner portals need rotation or partner notification; foundry NDAs often require it.

California: reimburse return shipping (LC 2802) and never deduct unreturned equipment from final pay (LC 221). Elsewhere, deductions are equally risky (India authorized deductions only; China and Taiwan require wages paid in full).
Set a neutral auto-reply for 30 days and do not forward mail to personal accounts; preserve the mailbox for legal holds.

variations.how: Access is removed at notification and pay and benefits continue through the notice period (garden leave); badge access is limited to scheduled property returns.
Local IT hub or courier collection in-country. Shipping devices containing personal information or controlled technology across borders (especially out of China) needs a PIPL and export review first.
Access is already suspended; arrange courier return and certification by e-signature.

countries.us: Revoke access to controlled-technology repositories and record the date, and for foreign-national departures update deemed-export license records and the technology control plan (EAR 15 CFR 734.13(b)). Recover equipment with a signed return/deletion certification, and review 30-90 days of download activity before exit for key engineers (DTSA).
countries.us-ca: Revoke access immediately at separation and forensically image high-risk devices, but do not withhold or deduct final pay for unreturned items (LC 221). Reimburse return shipping and other necessary expenses (LC 2802), and disclose device and account review of former employees in the CCPA notice at collection.
countries.ca: Revoke access on the notice date or at the meeting, recover devices and certify return of data. Log exits of export-controlled technology holders under the technology control plan, because releases to third-country nationals in Canada are deemed reexports, and rely on confidentiality and breach-of-confidence remedies rather than non-competes (void in ON below the C-suite).
countries.in: Collect devices and badges and revoke access on the last working day, but run clearance in parallel so it never delays F&F within 2 working days. DPDP s.7(i) supports DLP and forensic review to protect trade secrets and IP, with proportionality and notice, and Karnataka bans retaining employees' original documents.
countries.tw: Recover devices, revoke access, obtain a written return and non-retention certification, and review recent downloads under the monitoring policy disclosed in the PDPA notice. Remind the employee of Trade Secrets Act and National Security Act exposure for core key technologies.
countries.cn: Use a handover checklist covering devices, lab notebooks and confidential data, with certified deletion from personal devices, and revoke access at exit; economic compensation is payable on completion of handover (LCL Art. 50). Device reviews involving personal information need a PIPL basis (separate consent for sensitive PI) and counsel review, given Counter-Espionage Law and Data Security Law sensitivities.

processes.name: Exit survey & interview program
processes.summary: Runs the global exit listening program: who is invited and when, third-party survey plus HR interview, country privacy notices and consents, reporting thresholds, triage of allegations to ER and Ethics, and regretted-attrition analytics for leadership and the Board. Good looks like a response rate of at least 50% among voluntary leavers, every allegation triaged within 1 business day, no report cut below n=5, and quarterly insights with actions tracked to closure.
processes.owner: HR Analytics (program and reporting), HRBP (interviews and actions), Employee Relations and Ethics & Compliance (allegation triage)
processes.trigger: A termination with a notice date entered in Darwinbox (voluntary exits auto-invited; involuntary per rules), plus the quarterly reporting calendar.
outputs: T-EXIT-SURVEY responses in the survey platform with notice and consent records
T-EXIT-INTERVIEW notes stored with restricted access
ER/Ethics case numbers for every allegation raised
Quarterly regretted-attrition and exit-insight report to the executive team; semiannual summary to the Comp Committee/Board
30-90 day post-exit pulse results
Action tracker with owners and closure status
processes.sla: Survey invite within 1 business day of notice; interview before the last day; allegation triage within 1 business day; quarterly report within 15 business days of quarter end.

steps.label: Exit logged; eligibility checked
steps.detail: When a termination with a notice date is entered in Darwinbox, rules assign the listening track. Voluntary leavers get the survey and an interview. Involuntary leavers get an optional survey after exit only, and RIF leavers get a separate process-experience survey. Deaths and employees in active litigation (Legal flag) are excluded.

steps.label: Send privacy notice and invite
steps.detail: The third-party survey platform sends the invite within 1 business day of notice, in the employee's language (English, Simplified or Traditional Chinese). It carries the country privacy notice and consent screens, including separate PIPL consent for cross-border transfer in China. The wording promises 'confidential, reported only in groups of 5 or more' and says allegations of misconduct will be acted on.
steps.control: Notice acknowledgment and any required consent are captured before responses are accepted.

steps.label: Complete exit survey
steps.detail: A 10-12 minute T-EXIT-SURVEY covering primary and secondary reasons from a fixed taxonomy, manager and career questions, pay competitiveness, destination type, and whether the employee would return. Sensitive topics (health, family) appear only as optional free text.

steps.label: Conduct exit interview
steps.detail: An HRBP, never the employee's manager, holds a 30-45 minute T-EXIT-INTERVIEW in the final week. Regretted senior leavers and executives get a skip-level or external interviewer. Notes are factual, stored in restricted Document management, and never shared with the manager in identifiable form.

steps.label: Allegation or risk raised?
steps.detail: HRBP reviews survey free text and interview notes for allegations: harassment, discrimination, retaliation, safety, fraud, securities, export or data misuse. The employee's departure does not end the company's duty to act.

steps.label: Triage allegation within 1 bd
steps.detail: ER logs a case (ER-01), decides whether to investigate (ER-02), tells the employee how it will be handled, and confirms non-retaliation. India POSH complaints go to the Internal Committee; Taiwan harassment and bullying complaints follow the statutory channel.
steps.control: Every flagged exit record carries a case number.

steps.label: Route compliance and securities issues
steps.detail: Accounting, auditing and securities concerns go to the audit committee process (SOX 301). Export, sanctions and FCPA matters go to Legal immediately to protect the DOJ 120-day self-disclosure window. The employee is told that nothing restricts reporting to the SEC or other agencies (Rule 21F-17).

steps.label: Code and store responses
steps.detail: HR Analytics codes free text to the reason taxonomy and joins HRIS attributes: regretted flag, level, tenure, site, manager, performance, destination. Identifiable data stays under restricted access, analysis uses pseudonymized copies, and identifiable responses are deleted or anonymized per the retention schedule.

steps.label: Send 30-90 day post-exit pulse
steps.detail: A 5-question pulse 30-90 days after the last day asks for the real reason in hindsight, whether the new role met expectations, and interest in returning. With the person's consent, boomerang interest routes to OF-10.

steps.label: Analyze regretted attrition
steps.detail: Each quarter, HR Analytics analyzes regretted and total attrition by function, critical-skill cluster (analog/mixed-signal, physical design, verification, firmware), site, level and manager, with top reasons and competitor destinations. It cross-references engagement and stay-interview data and flags managers with repeat regretted exits.

steps.label: Every cut meets n>=5?
steps.detail: Any cut with fewer than 5 responses is suppressed or rolled up (site to country, quarter to year) before reporting. Free-text quotes appear only after de-identification.
steps.control: BI suppression rule blocks cuts with n<5.

steps.label: Report to ELT and Board
steps.detail: CHRO presents the quarterly exit and regretted-attrition report to the executive team and a semiannual summary to the Comp Committee/Board. It uses the same metric definitions as the 10-K human capital section.

steps.label: Agree actions with leaders
steps.detail: HRBPs agree 1-3 actions per function with named owners and dates (e.g., career-path fixes, manager coaching, pay-range reviews via CO-01/CO-05) and log them in the action tracker.

steps.label: Close the loop with employees
steps.detail: Leaders share aggregated 'you said, we did' updates in town halls and team meetings. HRBPs track completion and re-measure the next quarter.

steps.label: Cycle closed; actions tracked
steps.detail: HR Analytics archives the quarter's report and tracker status, and open actions roll into the next cycle.

raci.activity: Program design, questionnaire and reason taxonomy
Privacy notices and consents by country
Action planning and closing the loop

controls.control: The country privacy notice is delivered, and consent captured where required (PIPL separate consent; sensitive items optional), before responses are accepted.
controls.evidence: Notice/consent log in the survey platform

controls.control: Reports never show a cut with fewer than 5 respondents, and free text is shown only after de-identification.
controls.evidence: BI suppression configuration and report QA checklist

controls.control: Each week, survey free text and interview notes are reviewed for allegation keywords, and any unrouted allegation is escalated.
Identifiable exit data is accessible only to HR Analytics and the assigned HRBP; managers never see identifiable responses.
Each quarter, invite coverage is reconciled against voluntary terminations in HRIS.
Identifiable responses are deleted or anonymized when the retention period ends.

kpis.name: Survey response rate (voluntary leavers)
kpis.why: Below this, the reasons data is not representative.

kpis.name: Exit interviews completed for regretted leavers
kpis.why: Regretted exits carry the most actionable insight.

kpis.name: Allegations triaged within 1 business day
kpis.why: Unrouted allegations create legal and whistleblower exposure.

kpis.name: Regretted attrition vs plan
kpis.why: Tracks retention of critical chip-design talent.

kpis.name: Action items closed on time
kpis.why: Proves the program changes something.

kpis.name: Quarter end to report
kpis.why: Stale insights don't get acted on.

considerations: Use a third-party survey platform for candour and an HRBP interview for depth. For executives and top regretted leavers, use a skip-level or external interviewer.
Promise 'confidential, reported in aggregate', never 'anonymous'. Responses are linked to HRIS attributes, and allegations must be acted on.
Timing trade-off: a survey right after notice captures fresh reasons but guarded answers, while the 30-90 day post-exit pulse gets candour. Run both and compare.

Involuntary leavers: no interview at or near the termination meeting, only an optional survey after exit. RIF leavers get a process-experience survey, and anyone in or threatening litigation is excluded on Legal's flag.

Once HR hears an allegation, the company is on notice. A departure doesn't end the duty to investigate harassment, retaliation, securities fraud or export violations, and ignoring it looks bad in any later claim.

Privacy is not uniform. In China, a voluntary survey is unlikely to fall under the HR-necessity basis, so get notice and separate consent for sensitive PI and for cross-border transfer to a US vendor, plus a PIPIA. India's DPDP duties start 13 May 2027, but a voluntary survey should already be consent-based under the SPDI Rules. Apply BC PIPA standards across Canada; in California, give the CCPA notice at collection.

Keep the reason taxonomy stable (separating 'pull' factors such as comp or competitor offer from 'push' factors such as manager or workload) so trends and the 10-K human capital narrative stay comparable year over year.
Any AI used to code free text or predict attrition is an ADS under California CRD rules and, from 2027, ADMT under CPPA rules. Bias-test it and keep a human reviewer.
Board reporting should focus on regretted exits in critical skills and where they go: TSMC and MediaTek in Taiwan, state-backed domestic chip firms in China, GCC competitors in Bengaluru.

variations.how: CHRO or an external interviewer conducts it, and results go only to the CEO and CHRO. Too few cases to include in analytics cuts; Section 16 and 8-K sensitivities apply.
Optional process-experience survey after exit only (clarity, dignity, support). Results feed OF-02/OF-03 process improvement, not attrition analytics.

variations.when: Employee raises an allegation but asks for no action
variations.how: Explain the duty to act. ER assesses and protects the reporter's identity as far as possible, and non-retaliation is confirmed in writing.

Simplified Chinese survey, a separate consent screen for cross-border transfer to the US vendor, and in-country storage if the vendor offers it (verify). Investigation data stays onshore unless counsel clears transfer.

variations.when: Small sites (e.g., fewer than 5 leavers per quarter)
variations.how: Roll up to country or annual reporting. Never show site-level cuts that identify individuals.

variations.when: Leaver going to a competitor with trade-secret risk
variations.how: Keep the exit interview separate from the ER-10 investigation. The interviewer only reminds the employee of confidentiality duties and does not question them about data.
With consent, tag the leaver for the alumni network and rehire pipeline (OF-10) and note their rehire eligibility code.

countries.us: Surveys are voluntary and the notes are discoverable, so keep them factual. Discrimination, harassment, retaliation, wage or whistleblower allegations go to ER within 1 business day. Ask about unreported compliance concerns and route accounting and securities matters to the audit committee process (SOX 301); nothing in the survey or exit certification may discourage contact with the SEC or other agencies (Rule 21F-17). NLRA Section 7 protects non-supervisory employees' criticism of pay and conditions, so never tie severance or references to exit feedback.
countries.us-ca: CCPA covers exit survey and interview data. Give a notice at collection (categories, purposes, retention), and honor post-exit requests to know, delete and correct within 45 days, subject to employment-law exceptions. AI coding or attrition prediction is an ADS under the CRD regulations (4-year record retention) and, from 1 Jan 2027, ADMT under the CPPA rules when it feeds significant decisions. Keep exit records tied to personnel decisions for 4 years (Gov Code 12946).
countries.ca: Ontario has no private-sector statute for employee data, so apply BC PIPA-level standards company-wide. BC PIPA allows collection that is reasonable for ending employment, with notice, but an optional survey should rely on express notice and voluntary participation, with access requests answered within PIPA timelines. Tell employees the data is processed by the US parent and its vendors. Quebec remote employees need Law 25 notices and a privacy impact assessment before transfer outside Quebec; PIPEDA does not cover provincially regulated employee data (Bill C-36 is pending).
countries.in: DPDP's notice, consent and rights duties start on 13 May 2027. Until then, follow the SPDI Rules (written consent for sensitive data, a published privacy policy, a grievance officer). A voluntary exit survey is not core employment processing, so use a clear notice and consent now and plan for DPDP consent-manager and 90-day rights handling. POSH allegations must go to the Internal Committee even though the complainant is leaving; attrition in Bengaluru VLSI and verification roles typically runs in the low-to-mid teens (%), so report regretted exits by skill cluster.
countries.tw: Give a PDPA notice at collection (purpose, categories, period, area including transfer to the US parent or vendor, rights), and get written consent for any sensitive data such as health. Provide Traditional Chinese versions. Route workplace bullying allegations (OSH Act chapter in force since 1 July 2026) and sexual harassment allegations to the statutory complaint process, and share competitor destinations and offer patterns (e.g., TSMC and MediaTek profit-sharing) with Total Rewards.
countries.cn: PIPL applies. The HR-necessity basis is unlikely to cover a voluntary exit survey, so give notice and obtain consent, with separate consent for any sensitive PI and for cross-border transfer to a US survey vendor or HRIS, backed by a PIPIA kept 3 years. Use Simplified Chinese and avoid questions on health, family or political views. Handle allegations locally with counsel, mindful of Data Security Law and Counter-Espionage Law limits on moving investigation data offshore.

processes.name: Retirement
processes.summary: Manages retirement exits: employee-initiated notice, statutory retirement rules where they exist (China's rising ages, Taiwan LSA retirement), pension and retirement-benefit claims, equity retirement provisions and knowledge transfer. Good looks like no age-based pressure where retirement is not mandatory, statutory pension steps done on time, and equity retirement terms applied exactly as written.
processes.owner: HRBP (process), Total Rewards and Stock Admin (retirement benefits and equity), People Ops (execution)
processes.trigger: Employee gives notice of intent to retire, or a statutory event occurs (China pension eligibility under the new retirement ages; Taiwan LSA retirement conditions).
outputs: Retirement acknowledgment with last day and knowledge-transfer plan
Retirement benefit/pension claim support per country
Equity retirement eligibility determination and statement
Final pay and statutory documents via OF-05
processes.sla: Acknowledge within 2 business days; benefit and equity determinations issued 10 business days before the last day.

steps.label: Give notice of retirement
steps.detail: The employee tells the manager or HRBP in writing when they intend to retire. Managers never start retirement conversations based on age. In China, voluntary early retirement needs 3 months' notice from the employee.

steps.label: Confirm last day and transition plan
steps.detail: HRBP confirms the last day and a 3-6 month knowledge-transfer plan for critical roles (legacy product lines, analog IP, key customers). Any phased-retirement or consulting option goes through PL-05 classification review.

steps.label: Determine retirement benefits
steps.detail: Total Rewards confirms the benefits due: US 401(k) distribution options and any retiree medical; Taiwan old-system retirement pay; India gratuity and EPF/EPS; China pension application; Canada group RRSP/DPSP transfer.

steps.label: Meets equity retirement definition?
steps.detail: Stock Admin checks age and service against each grant agreement's retirement definition, using HRIS hire date and date of birth.

steps.label: Apply retirement vesting terms
steps.detail: Stock Admin applies the plan's retirement treatment (continued or pro-rata vesting, extended exercise window) and confirms withholding timing with Tax and Payroll (verify FICA timing for retirement-eligible awards).
steps.control: A second reviewer validates eligibility against plan terms and HRIS dates.

steps.label: Process exit and statutory filings
steps.detail: People Ops processes the exit with reason code Retirement and final pay under OF-05, plus the country filings. China: pension application, with the contract ending on pension receipt. Taiwan: insurance withdrawal and pension report within 7 days. India: F&F within 2 working days and gratuity within 30 days.

steps.label: Retirement recognized; file closed
steps.detail: Manager and HRBP hold a recognition event (EN-02) and invite the retiree to the alumni network (OF-10).

controls.control: Before any statement is issued, a second reviewer validates equity retirement eligibility against the plan definition and HRIS dates.
In China, the retirement-age calculator (2025 NPCSC decision) and contribution-years check run before any contract end, and the contract ends only on pension receipt.
An annual review confirms no mandatory retirement is applied in the US or Canada.

kpis.name: Retirement benefit and pension filings on time
kpis.why: Late filings delay retirees' income and create statutory exposure (China, Taiwan, India).

kpis.name: Knowledge-transfer plan in place 30+ days before last day (critical roles)
kpis.why: Long-tenure engineers often hold undocumented product and customer knowledge.

considerations: Never ask about retirement plans in the US or Canada. Discuss retirement only when the employee raises it, and base succession on roles, not ages (ADEA, FEHA, human rights codes).
Define equity 'retirement' consistently in plan documents (e.g., minimum age plus service) and apply it mechanically. Retirement-eligible awards can change payroll-tax timing, so confirm with Tax.
Phased retirement or consulting needs a real classification review (PL-05; California ABC test). In China, work after pension receipt is a labor-service relationship, not a labor contract.
Start knowledge transfer early for long-tenure analog, legacy-product and customer-facing engineers; 3-6 months of overlap is typical.

variations.when: China employee reaches the new statutory age without minimum contribution years
variations.how: The contract continues until pension receipt; agreed deferral up to 3 years is documented in writing.
Calculate old-system retirement pay from the reserve fund (Art. 55, verify formula) and pay within 30 days; new-system service is in the individual pension account.

variations.when: Retiree returns as consultant or part-time
variations.how: Route through PL-05 and TA-10, and check whether the equity plan's continued-service rules affect retirement vesting.

countries.us: There is no mandatory retirement age: the ADEA protects employees 40+ (with a narrow exception for bona fide high-level policymaking executives with qualifying retirement benefits; verify thresholds), so retirement is employee-initiated. Provide 401(k) distribution and 402(f) rollover notices and COBRA/Medicare coordination information, and apply the equity plan's retirement definition exactly as written.
countries.us-ca: FEHA protects employees 40+ and bars mandatory retirement for most roles. Retirement is treated as a resignation for final pay (on the last day with 72+ hours' notice under LC 202), with the UI Code 1089, DE 2320, HIPP and COBRA/Cal-COBRA notices.
countries.ca: Neither ON nor BC has a mandatory retirement age, and forcing retirement is age discrimination under the human rights codes. Treat retirement as a resignation: final pay in ON by the later of 7 days or the next payday, in BC within 6 days, plus an ROE; group RRSP/DPSP balances transfer under plan rules.
countries.in: There is no statutory private-sector retirement age: the superannuation age (typically 58 or 60) comes from the contract, standing orders or policy, and gratuity is payable on superannuation within 30 days alongside F&F within 2 working days. Support EPF final settlement and the EPS pension claim.
countries.tw: An employer may compel retirement only on LSA Art. 54 grounds (age 65, or mental or physical incapacity), and employees may retire voluntarily under Art. 53 (e.g., 15 years' service at age 55, 25 years' service, or 10 years' service at age 60) (verify). Old-system seniority earns Art. 55 retirement pay within 30 days, new-system service is funded through the Labor Pension individual account, and the pension stop is reported within 7 days.
countries.cn: Statutory retirement ages are rising gradually from 1 Jan 2025 over 15 years (men 60 to 63; female cadres 55 to 58; female workers 50 to 55); voluntary early retirement of up to 3 years needs the employee's 3 months' notice, agreed deferral of up to 3 years is possible, and minimum contribution years rise from 15 toward 20 starting 2030. The contract ends when the employee starts receiving pension (reaching the age alone is not enough), and staff with 15+ years' service within 5 years of retirement age are protected from Art. 40/41 termination.

processes.name: Death of an employee
processes.summary: A compassionate, coordinated response to an employee's death: one family liaison, workplace notification and support, incident reporting if work-related, and correct payment of wages, insurance, survivor benefits and equity to the lawful recipients. Good looks like a named liaison within 24 hours, no automated system messages reaching the family, and every entitlement paid to the right person under local law, with one written summary.
processes.owner: HRBP (family liaison and process), with Payroll, Benefits and Stock Admin (entitlements) and EHS (work-related deaths)
processes.trigger: Notification of an employee's death from family, a colleague, the manager or authorities.
outputs: Named family liaison and contact log
HRIS 'deceased' status that stops automated communications, surveys and direct deposit
Final wages paid to the lawful recipient (estate, successor affidavit or nominee)
Insurance, survivor-benefit and equity claims filed; written entitlements summary to the family
Regulator incident report where work-related
processes.sla: Liaison assigned within 24 hours; entitlements summary to the family within 10 business days; payments within 30 days of receiving required documents.

steps.label: Notify HRBP of the death
steps.detail: The manager informs the HRBP immediately and confirms the facts respectfully. Nothing is announced to the team until the family agrees to what may be shared.

steps.label: Assign family liaison
steps.detail: HRBP names one liaison, sends condolences and asks the family's communication preferences. HRBP also arranges EAP and grief support for the team and coordinates any memorial with the family's wishes and cultural or religious practices.

steps.label: Work-related death?
steps.detail: EHS determines whether the death occurred at work, during work travel, or from a work-related cause (including sudden death at work in China).

steps.label: Report and investigate incident
steps.detail: EHS reports within the regulatory window: OSHA and Cal/OSHA 8 hours; Taiwan labor inspection 8 hours; China work-injury recognition application within 30 days. EHS then runs the HS-01 investigation, with Legal placing a hold.

steps.label: Stop automated notices; update HRIS
steps.detail: People Ops sets 'deceased' status to stop system emails, exit surveys, payslip notifications and direct deposit. IT preserves the account and data. Company property is retrieved gently through the liaison.
steps.control: HRIS status change blocks automated workflows; confirmation logged.

steps.label: Pay final wages to lawful payee
steps.detail: Payroll pays wages, accrued vacation and other amounts due to the lawful recipient under local rules: a successor affidavit (e.g., CA Probate Code 13600), the estate, or the registered nominee (India). Tax reporting is set with Payroll tax.
steps.control: Payment only against the required documents (death certificate, affidavit or letters, nomination) reviewed by Payroll and Legal.

steps.label: File life and survivor claims
steps.detail: Benefits files group life and AD&D claims, offers COBRA to dependents, and supports statutory survivor benefits: India gratuity and EDLI/PF; China funeral subsidy and survivor pension; Taiwan Labor Insurance death benefits; Canada CPP death benefit.

steps.label: Apply death terms to equity
steps.detail: Stock Admin applies the plan's death provisions (acceleration or continued vesting where provided, extended exercise window) and gives the estate transfer instructions and document requirements.

steps.label: Entitlements summary to family
steps.detail: The liaison sends one written summary of all entitlements, amounts, forms and contacts, and follows up until every claim is paid.

raci.activity: Final pay and tax to lawful recipient

controls.control: 'Deceased' status in the HRIS blocks automated emails, surveys and direct deposit to the deceased's account.
controls.evidence: HRIS change log and workflow suppression confirmation

controls.control: Payment to an estate or survivor is released only against the required documents, reviewed by Payroll and Legal.
Work-related deaths are reported within regulatory windows (8 hours US/CA/Taiwan; 30-day work-injury application in China).
controls.evidence: Agency submission receipts in the EHS log

kpis.name: Liaison assigned within 24 hours
kpis.why: The family's first experience of the company after the death.

kpis.name: Entitlements paid within 30 days of documents
kpis.why: Delays add hardship at the worst time.

kpis.name: Automated messages reaching the deceased's contacts after notification
kpis.why: Tests the HRIS suppression control.

considerations: The family decides what is shared and when. Respect cultural and religious practices on timing and contact, e.g., quick cremation customs in India and funeral customs in China.
Support the team: EAP and grief counselling, workload relief, and bereavement leave for colleagues or relatives employed by the company (CA 5 days; ON 2; BC 3; Taiwan 3-8 by relationship; China 1-3).
US tax: wages paid after death in the year of death generally carry FICA but not income-tax withholding and are reported to the recipient (verify with Payroll tax).
Preserve the mailbox and files. Family requests for personal photos or documents go through Legal and Privacy.

variations.when: Death at work or during business travel
variations.how: HS-02 crisis response with Security and the travel vendor (repatriation of remains, family travel), regulator reporting and a legal hold.
Immigration advises dependents on status implications (verify timelines) and the company offers practical relocation support.

variations.when: Death after resignation notice or during leave
variations.how: Entitlements are calculated the same way. Check whether equity death provisions still apply before the termination date.

countries.us: Pay wages owed to the estate or a designated successor under state law (many states allow direct payment of small wage amounts to a surviving spouse or next of kin; verify state limits), and report a work-related fatality to OSHA within 8 hours. Offer COBRA to surviving dependents, process group life/AD&D and 401(k) beneficiary claims, and apply the equity plan's death provisions (commonly an extended exercise window).
countries.us-ca: Probate Code 13600 lets a surviving spouse or other successor collect unpaid wages, including accrued vacation, by affidavit up to a statutory cap (verify the current amount); otherwise pay the estate. Report a work-related death to Cal/OSHA within 8 hours, provide COBRA/Cal-COBRA notices to dependents, and keep any medical information confidential (CMIA).
countries.ca: Pay outstanding wages and vacation pay to the estate (verify provincial rules on paying next of kin without probate), and issue the ROE and the final-year T4. Help the family claim the CPP death and survivor benefits and group life.
countries.in: Pay F&F to the registered nominee: gratuity is payable on death with no 5-year minimum, and PF and EDLI are claimed by the nominee through EPFO (EDLI contribution 0.5%; verify current benefit amounts). If the death arises out of employment, employee compensation under the SS Code applies (or ESI dependants' benefit for covered employees).
countries.tw: Report a workplace death to the labor inspection agency within 8 hours; occupational deaths trigger LSA employer compensation duties (funeral expenses and death compensation; verify amounts), offset by Labor Insurance and occupational accident insurance benefits. Pay outstanding wages and unused leave to the heirs, and help the family with Labor Pension individual-account and Labor Insurance death-benefit claims (verify).
countries.cn: Pay outstanding wages to the lawful heirs; basic pension insurance provides a funeral subsidy and survivor pension to dependents under the Social Insurance Law (verify local amounts). Sudden death at work, or within 48 hours of onset at work, counts as a work injury; apply for recognition within 30 days to access the one-time death subsidy, funeral subsidy and dependants' pension (verify amounts).

processes.name: Alumni, references & rehire eligibility
processes.summary: Governs what the company says about former employees (neutral references, employment verification, statutory letters and certificates), how rehire eligibility is set and used, and the alumni and boomerang program. Good looks like all references routed centrally, statutory certificates issued on time, documented and consistently reviewed rehire codes, and an alumni pipeline that produces boomerang hires.
processes.owner: People Ops (references, verification, certificates), HRBP (rehire eligibility), Recruiter (alumni and boomerang pipeline)
processes.trigger: Termination processed (rehire code required), a reference, verification or certificate request, or an alumni program cycle.
outputs: Rehire eligibility code with documented reason in Darwinbox
Verification and reference response log
Statutory letters and certificates: India relieving/experience letters, China 离职证明, Taiwan service certificate, US state service letters on request
Opt-in alumni network and boomerang prospect pool in Greenhouse
processes.sla: Rehire code set at termination; verification within 2 business days; Karnataka service certificate within 7 days of request; China certificate at termination.

steps.label: Exit processed; code requested
steps.detail: When the termination is processed, Darwinbox prompts the HRBP for a rehire code and People Ops checks which statutory letters the country requires.

steps.label: Set rehire eligibility code
steps.detail: HRBP sets Eligible, Eligible with review, or Not eligible. Not eligible needs documented misconduct (integrity, violence, trade-secret or export breach) and ER approval, and a manager cannot set it alone. RIF and performance exits default to Eligible or Eligible with review.
steps.control: 'Not eligible' requires a documented reason and ER approval in the Darwinbox workflow.

steps.label: Issue statutory exit letters
steps.detail: People Ops issues the country letters. India: relieving and experience letters (Karnataka service certificate within 7 days of request). China: 离职证明 at termination. Taiwan: service certificate on request, with no adverse remarks. US: state service letters on request (e.g., MN, MO).

steps.label: Reference request type?
steps.detail: Requests are triaged: employment verification (dates, title) versus requests for a substantive reference or opinion.

steps.label: Verify dates and title only
steps.detail: People Ops or the verification vendor (DS-07) confirms dates of employment and last title. Salary is released only with the former employee's written consent.

steps.label: Decline and redirect to People Ops
steps.detail: Managers do not give company references. They redirect the request to People Ops, which answers as a verification. Any exception (e.g., senior hires) needs Legal approval under POL-56.

steps.label: Maintain alumni and boomerang pool
steps.detail: Recruiting invites leavers coded Eligible to the opt-in alumni network, with its own privacy notice, and tags boomerang interest from the exit pulse (OF-07) as a Greenhouse prospect pool.

steps.label: Rehire applicant eligible?
steps.detail: When a former employee applies, the recruiter checks the code and, for 'Eligible with review', gets HRBP and ER sign-off before the process continues (TA-10).

steps.label: Proceed with rehire (TA-10)
steps.detail: The rehire continues through TA-10 with service-credit, equity and background-check rules applied.

steps.label: Decline, or review old code
steps.detail: The applicant is declined neutrally. Codes older than 3 years (other than integrity, violence or trade-secret matters) get an HRBP review before a final decision.

controls.control: 'Not eligible' codes require a documented reason and ER approval, and are reviewed quarterly for consistency across protected groups.
controls.evidence: Darwinbox audit trail and quarterly review memo

controls.control: References and verifications are answered only by People Ops or the verification vendor, and every response is logged.
Statutory letter timeliness is tracked (Karnataka 7 days; China at termination; Taiwan on request).

kpis.name: Statutory certificates issued on time
kpis.why: Missed certificates carry fines (Karnataka) or damages (China Art. 89).

kpis.name: Boomerang hires as % of experienced hires
kpis.why: Alumni are pre-vetted, ramp faster and cost less to hire.

kpis.name: Verification turnaround <=2 business days
kpis.why: Slow verification costs former employees jobs and invites complaints.

considerations: A neutral policy (dates and title; salary only with consent) keeps defamation risk low. Where there is a genuine safety concern (e.g., documented violence), take Legal advice rather than staying silent or improvising.
Rehire codes are evidence. They must reflect documented conduct, not a manager's opinion, be consistent across groups, and never be used to punish complainants.
Don't hold relieving or experience letters hostage (India) or add adverse remarks to Taiwan service certificates or China termination certificates. Statutory letters say what the law requires.
Keep alumni data separate from HR records and opt-in only. Contact details are personal data under PIPL, DPDP, PDPA and CCPA, so each needs its own notice.
Boomerangs: set rules up front for service credit (vacation accrual, severance tenure, India gratuity continuity), new equity grants and background re-checks.

variations.when: Employee resigned during an open investigation
variations.how: Code 'Eligible with review' with an ER note, and never state unproven findings in any reference or certificate.
Apply the service-bridging policy, a new equity grant (no reinstatement of forfeited awards unless the plan allows), and an abbreviated background check.
Handled by the verification vendor under the standard verification scope; no opinion content.

countries.us: There is no federal reference mandate: adopt a neutral policy (dates and title) and answer state service-letter requests where required (e.g., MN within 10 working days of request; MO; verify other states). Route employment verifications through DS-07; truthful, documented, limited statements keep defamation risk low.
countries.us-ca: Truthful, good-faith references are privileged (Civ. Code 47(c)), but misrepresentations meant to stop someone getting a job are prohibited (LC 1050-1053). Settlement agreements with good-faith claimants cannot bar rehire except in narrow cases such as a documented sexual harassment finding (CCP 1002.5).
countries.ca: There is no statutory reference or service-letter duty (the ROE is the statutory separation document), but defamatory or bad-faith references can add damages. Confirm dates and title and stay consistent with the termination letter.
countries.in: Relieving and experience letters are market standard and must not be withheld to force notice-period service. Karnataka requires a service certificate within 7 days of request (2026 amendment) and bans retaining employees' original certificates.
countries.tw: On request, the employer must issue a certificate of service (dates, position) and may not refuse or add adverse remarks the employee did not ask for (LSA Art. 19). Employer-initiated exits also need the involuntary separation certificate for EI benefits.
countries.cn: Issue the 离职证明 at termination stating the contract term, termination date, position and years of service, and omit negative reasons unless required (LCL Art. 50). Failing to issue it and causing loss (e.g., a lost new job) attracts damages (Art. 89).
